quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on his basketball background and path to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: My dad played professionally in Germany for 10 years and then he was a high school coach.
quotes.quote: My dad played professionally in Germany for 10 years and then he was a high school coach. I have an older brother, I have cousins that play college ball, so I just felt like nobody ever made it to the league, and I just felt like with all the knowledge before me, as long as I listen, do what I need to do, I'm traveling across the country at a young age, and I felt like I was up there with the best. As long as you stay on track, you stay the course, you're going to be good.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on his college recruitment and injury setback
quotes.excerpt: Clemson, Purdue recruited me hard, but I got injured in football my junior year.
quotes.quote: Clemson, Purdue recruited me hard, but I got injured in football my junior year, which is the most important recruiting year for you. I was getting recruited by bigger schools for football than basketball. I had like 15 D1 offers for hoops, but they were all like mid-major, which isn't bad, but I got hurt and my coach had a relationship with my dad because he was coaching at UC while my dad was around. I went up there on a visit and he's like, everything they say about you, if it's true, you're good with us. For him to have that trust, I'm still hurt, I don't know how I'm going to come back.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on his college team and playing with Jackson Hayes
quotes.excerpt: I played with Jackson Hayes who just signed with Utah and a bunch of other D1 guys.
quotes.quote: I played with Jackson Hayes who just signed with Utah and a bunch of other D1 guys, so we were trying to have one of the best teams in Ohio history. To get hurt, but I still came back for the last two games of the season and we won state, so it was a cool little story.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on the transition from college to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The thing that helps people get to college, get to the league is knowing basketball.
quotes.quote: The thing that helps people get to college, get to the league is knowing basketball, the foundation of basketball, the fundamentals, how to play with other really good players. That's what really gets people and propels them to have a good career. And then you got to learn the NBA game, the no-three-seconds, all the little tidbits of the NBA, all the rules, all the different stuff. And then I'm playing against Lance Stevenson, and I'm trying to get into a help defense, and then he grabs my arm so I can't go swipe at the ball. It's little things like that that you start picking up as you go on and go on.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on his draft night experience and joining the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I had no preference coming out. I was just like, whoever gives me is going to get a dog.
quotes.quote: I had no preference coming out. I was just like, whoever gives me is going to get a dog. I had a crazy draft range. I had people tell me I could go as high as 16 and as low as 40. So it was like a crazy draft range, so I wasn't really tripping. I'm like, as long as I get to the league, I'm going to make it work. I came up to New York when I was like 16 for AAU, playing at Basketball City, and I didn't like it at all. I'm from a smaller city, it was so much going on, I was in Chinatown, I was like, I don't know what's going on or where I'm at.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on the Knicks' playoff run and his arrival
quotes.excerpt: They had that playoff run when they lost to Atlanta, so I started seeing the hype.
quotes.quote: They had that playoff run when they lost to Atlanta, so I started seeing the hype, I started seeing the fans were really about it. So then when I got drafted here, I was like, man, this is going to be crazy. They came off a playoff run, I felt like I could make an impact. I really felt good coming here. I knew the fans were crazy, like my first day I get drafted, I saw a Knicks fan wearing my jersey up here. It was crazy, so I'm like, man, everything is just about to fall in line.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on the most difficult players to defend
quotes.excerpt: Alicia Keys was definitely up there, Denzel, Ben Stiller, Tracy Morgan, Amar'e Stoudemire.
quotes.quote: Alicia Keys was definitely up there, Denzel, Ben Stiller, Tracy Morgan, Amar'e Stoudemire. It's not regular, but they're there every game, like Ben Stiller, that's crazy, you know what I mean? Like Tracy Morgan, Amar'e Stoudemire, too. You too, like seeing y'all, like, bro, it's crazy, like that's a regular game.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on Steph Curry breaking the record at MSG
quotes.excerpt: The one I think about is when Steph broke the record in the Garden.
quotes.quote: The one I think about is when Steph broke the record in the Garden. The finals, we've been through the playoffs, but the finals, the energy for that game was crazy. I remember warming up, and there already had to be at least 10,000 people in the arena by like, warmups. I warm up at like 4:45. You know what I mean? So 10,000 people already probably being in there, and then, bro, he hit the shot. I think we stopped the game for like 25 minutes. Really? Yeah, Tibs was pissed. Tibs was pissed.

quotes.quote: I like going down to Philly, getting wins for sure. I like going down to Philly, getting wins. Honestly, playing in Golden State, that's always cool. Miami, that's always cool. quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on his favorite NBA players growing up
quotes.excerpt: I really didn't have a team, LeBron, everybody watched from in Ohio.
quotes.quote: I really didn't have a team, LeBron, everybody watched from in Ohio. But when PG was killing in Indiana, that was dope. I liked OKC when KD, Russ, you know, those guys. But yeah, I didn't really have a team. I was heavy D-Wade, yeah, I was heavy D-Wade.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on his development and the impact of the OG Anunoby trade
quotes.excerpt: My third year, we made a big trade when we brought OG in.
quotes.quote: My third year, we made a big trade when we brought OG in, and then that cleared a lot of space for me to start playing, and I never looked back. I felt like I, you know, I was ready in my first couple years, and God always has a plan, so it's just got to stick with it. It was tough though, to not play, I grew up pretty much being a star on every team I was on, and then you got to take a backseat, but that's why I said like you got to get used to playing with other good players and starting your role.

quotes.speaker: Miles McBride
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles McBride on team dynamics during coaching changes and trades
quotes.excerpt: Everybody's like mad close I've played with. So it's tough, but it's like, it's the business.
quotes.quote: Everybody's like mad close I've played with. So it's tough, but it's like, it's the business. Like it's kind of, it is weird because like you're sad, you know, you wish them all the best, but then like, I mean, pretty much you got a game probably that night or the next day, so it's like, you just got to get over all that. You just got to move on. Like, I mean, when we traded for like Josh Hart, like he was on the bench like that night or something, like it was that night or the next day, and it's just like, you just roll. Yeah, it happens mad fast in the league.

So it was a lot of like talk like that, like Jamal would talk to me. I had a good conversation like Ray Allen, like just about work ethic and like always just, you know, taking advantage of every moment, things like that. Like Taj Gibson, I mean, even, you know, Julius, Evan Fournier, like we had a I had a good good group of vets my my rookie year.
